about_the_game:
Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal that refuses to let you die. REVENGE CRYSTAL blends tight, precise top-down Soulslike combat with Metroidvania-style exploration across a ruined world of interconnected paths and elemental magic. You are not the knight—you are the will driving this vessel.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Soulslike combat: Skill-based fights built around timing, spacing, and smart decision-making—every mistake matters.

  • Elemental crystal system: Equip crystals to swap elements for your spells, sword, and arrows—exploit weaknesses and adapt mid-fight.

  • Metroidvania exploration: New traversal tools open shortcuts, reveal hidden routes, unlock sealed doors, and lead to secret areas.

  • Flexible builds: Shape the knight for melee, ranged, or magic—and combine them to create your own combat style.

  • Boss encounters: Ruthless bosses that punish mistakes and reward learning their tells, positioning, and elemental choices.

  • Lore and optional quests: Discover the world’s history through exploration, side content, and hidden encounters.

STORY:

In Al-Sadim, people live believing their world is all that exists—unaware of a hidden network of worlds linked by gateways they never discovered. Only the Crystallen opened those paths, arriving with promises of peace that demanded obedience… and any objection was met with force.

Then the invasion came: a merciless force that crosses worlds to wipe out the Crystallen and erase any land touched by their rule. With the world in ruins and history buried under ash, a knight awakens in the Forgotten Prison with no memory—only a crystal fused to his chest, the mark of a covenant he cannot recall. The invaders’ leaders are hunting him, and the gateways are waiting for anyone bold enough to step through.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (2GB) / AMD Radeon R9 380 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Target 1080p / Low / 30 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Target 1080p / High / 60 FPS

short_description: Possessed by a living crystal, fight for revenge in a top-down Soulslike action RPG. Master precise combat and elemental magic, explore a shattered world, solve deadly puzzles, and defeat brutal bosses to expose the Crystallen’s sins.
